source_refs.note: Exercise 8.2 Q2 (Regula-Falsi, 2 d.p.) on book p. 244; answers p. 307 (printed under '3.')

blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Find the real roots of nonlinear equations correct to 2 decimal places using the Regula-Falsi method, by finding some interval of sign change if not specified. \(3x^3 - 9x^2 + 8 = 0 ; [2, 3]\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh Regula-Falsi ka sawal hai aur interval \([2, 3]\) diya hua hai.
Equation \(3x^3 - 9x^2 + 8 = 0\) hai, is liye \(f(x) = 3x^3 - 9x^2 + 8\).
Find karna hai root 2 decimal places tak; tolerance 0.005.
Rule: secant line ka x-intercept, \(c = \frac{a f(b) - b f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\).
Plan: \(c\) nikalo, sign dekho, interval chhota karo, jab tak \(|f(c)| < 0.005\) na ho.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(3x^3 - 9x^2 + 8 = 0\) diya hua interval \([2, 3]\).
Maloom karna: root jo 2 decimal places tak sahi ho.
Tareeqa: Regula-Falsi (false position). Do points \((a, f(a))\) aur \((b, f(b))\) ko seedhi line (secant line) se jorte hain; yeh line x-axis ko jahan kaatti hai woh naya andaza \(c\) hai: \(c = \frac{a f(b) - b f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\). Phir woh hissa rakhte hain jahan sign abhi bhi badal raha ho. 2 decimal places ke liye tolerance \(|f(c)| < 0.005\) hai; beech ki values 4 decimals tak.

Continuity aur sign change check karein
\[f(x) = 3x^3 - 9x^2 + 8\]\[f(2) = 24 - 36 + 8 = -4\]\[f(3) = 81 - 81 + 8 = 8\]Yani \(f(2)\,f(3) < 0\).
Kyun: \(f\) har jagah continuous hai (polynomial hai, aur polynomial har jagah continuous hota hai). Continuous function ka sign badle to LRT kehta hai ke beech mein root zaroor hai.

Iteration 1: \(a = 2,\ b = 3\), \(f(a) = -4,\ f(b) = 8\)
\[c = \dfrac{a f(b) - b f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\]\[= \dfrac{(2)(8) - (3)(-4)}{8 - (-4)}\]\[= 2.3333\]\[f(2.3333) = -2.8891 < 0\]
Root ab \([2.3333, 3]\) mein hai, is liye \(a = c\).
Kyun: \(f(c)\) ka sign \(f(a)\) jaisa hai, is liye \(a\) hata kar \(c\) rakha; sign change ab \(c\) aur \(b\) ke beech hai.
Dhyan dein: formula mein negative values bracket ke saath likhein, warna minus ka sign gum ho jata hai.

Iteration 2: \(a = 2.3333,\ b = 3\), \(f(a) = -2.8891,\ f(b) = 8\)
\[c = \dfrac{a f(b) - b f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\]\[= \dfrac{(2.3333)(8) - (3)(-2.8891)}{8 - (-2.8891)}\]\[= 2.5102\]\[f(2.5102) = -1.2588 < 0\]
Root ab \([2.5102, 3]\) mein hai, is liye \(a = c\).
Kyun: \(f(c)\) ka sign \(f(a)\) jaisa hai, is liye \(a\) hata kar \(c\) rakha; sign change ab \(c\) aur \(b\) ke beech hai.
Dhyan dein: formula mein negative values bracket ke saath likhein, warna minus ka sign gum ho jata hai.

Isi tarah aage (table)
Table mein har iteration likhi hai. Ghaur karein ke \(b\) wala sira apni jagah se hilta hi nahin: curve poore hisse mein ek hi taraf mura hua hai, is liye secant line har dafa root ke ek hi taraf axis ko kaatti hai.
Kyun: Regula-Falsi mein sirf woh sira badalta hai jis ka sign \(f(c)\) jaisa ho. Bisection ki tarah dono siron ki bari bari nahin aati.

Rukna kab hai
\[|f(2.6076)| = 0.0045 < 0.005\]Is liye \(c = 2.6076\) kaafi hai; 2 decimal places tak \(x \approx 2.61\).
Kyun: \(n = 2\) ke liye 8.3.1 ki tolerance \(|f(c)| < 0.005\) hai, aur yeh poori ho gayi.

Tasdeeq:
\[f(2.605) = -0.0414\]\[f(2.615) = 0.1019\]Sign ulte hain, is liye asal root 2.605 aur 2.615 ke darmiyan hai, aur woh round ho kar 2.61 hi banta hai. Jawab pakka hai.

blocks.text: Answer key ki numbering: "3." ke neeche likhe jawab (2.61, −1.93, 0.85, 0.36) asal mein isi Question 2 ke hain.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Find the real roots of nonlinear equations correct to 2 decimal places using the Regula-Falsi method, by finding some interval of sign change if not specified. \(x^2 + 4\sin x = 0 ; [-2.2, -1]\)
blocks.explanation:
Regula-Falsi ka sawal; interval \([-2.2, -1]\) diya hai aur dono sire negative hain.
Function \(f(x) = x^2 + 4\sin x\); \(\sin\) ki wajah se radian mode.
Root 2 decimal places tak chahiye.
Negative numbers formula mein daalte waqt bracket zaroor lagayein, yahin sab se zyada ghaltiyan hoti hain.
Plan: \(c\) nikalo, sign dekho, interval chhota karo, \(|f(c)| < 0.005\) par ruko.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x^2 + 4\sin x = 0\) diya hua interval \([-2.2, -1]\).
Maloom karna: root jo 2 decimal places tak sahi ho.
Tareeqa: Regula-Falsi (false position). Do points \((a, f(a))\) aur \((b, f(b))\) ko seedhi line (secant line) se jorte hain; yeh line x-axis ko jahan kaatti hai woh naya andaza \(c\) hai: \(c = \frac{a f(b) - b f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\). Phir woh hissa rakhte hain jahan sign abhi bhi badal raha ho. 2 decimal places ke liye tolerance \(|f(c)| < 0.005\) hai; beech ki values 4 decimals tak.

Continuity aur sign change check karein
\[f(x) = x^2 + 4\sin x\]\[f(-2.2) = 4.84 + 4\sin(-2.2)\]\[= 4.84 - 3.2340 = 1.6060\]\[f(-1) = 1 + 4\sin(-1)\]\[= 1 - 3.3659 = -2.3659\]Yani \(f(-2.2)\,f(-1) < 0\).
Kyun: \(f\) har jagah continuous hai (polynomial aur sine dono continuous hain). Continuous function ka sign badle to LRT kehta hai ke beech mein root zaroor hai.

Iteration 1: \(a = -2.2,\ b = -1\), \(f(a) = 1.606,\ f(b) = -2.3659\)
\[c = \dfrac{a f(b) - b f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\]\[= \dfrac{(-2.2)(-2.3659) - (-1)(1.606)}{-2.3659 - (1.606)}\]\[= -1.7148\]\[f(-1.7148) = -1.0181 < 0\]
Root ab \([-2.2, -1.7148]\) mein hai, is liye \(b = c\).
Kyun: \(f(c)\) ka sign \(f(b)\) jaisa hai, is liye \(b\) hata kar \(c\) rakha; sign change ab \(a\) aur \(c\) ke beech hai.
Dhyan dein: formula mein negative values bracket ke saath likhein, warna minus ka sign gum ho jata hai.

Iteration 2: \(a = -2.2,\ b = -1.7148\), \(f(a) = 1.606,\ f(b) = -1.0181\)
\[c = \dfrac{a f(b) - b f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\]\[= \dfrac{(-2.2)(-1.0181) - (-1.7148)(1.606)}{-1.0181 - (1.606)}\]\[= -1.903\]\[f(-1.903) = -0.1599 < 0\]
Root ab \([-2.2, -1.903]\) mein hai, is liye \(b = c\).
Kyun: \(f(c)\) ka sign \(f(b)\) jaisa hai, is liye \(b\) hata kar \(c\) rakha; sign change ab \(a\) aur \(c\) ke beech hai.
Dhyan dein: formula mein negative values bracket ke saath likhein, warna minus ka sign gum ho jata hai.

Isi tarah aage (table)
Table mein har iteration likhi hai. Ghaur karein ke \(a\) wala sira apni jagah se hilta hi nahin: curve poore hisse mein ek hi taraf mura hua hai, is liye secant line har dafa root ke ek hi taraf axis ko kaatti hai.
Kyun: Regula-Falsi mein sirf woh sira badalta hai jis ka sign \(f(c)\) jaisa ho. Bisection ki tarah dono siron ki bari bari nahin aati.

Rukna kab hai
\[|f(-1.9333)| = 0.0024 < 0.005\]Is liye \(c = -1.9333\) kaafi hai; 2 decimal places tak \(x \approx -1.93\).
Kyun: \(n = 2\) ke liye 8.3.1 ki tolerance \(|f(c)| < 0.005\) hai, aur yeh poori ho gayi.

Tasdeeq:
\[f(-1.935) = 0.0066\]\[f(-1.925) = -0.0461\]Sign ulte hain, is liye asal root -1.935 aur -1.925 ke darmiyan hai, aur woh round ho kar -1.93 hi banta hai. Jawab pakka hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) [printed as \(xe_x = 2\)] Find the real roots of nonlinear equations correct to 2 decimal places using the Regula-Falsi method, by finding some interval of sign change if not specified. \(xe^{x} = 2\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein interval nahin diya, is liye pehle khud dhoondna hai.
Kitab ne \(xe_x = 2\) chhapa hai, lekin matlab \(xe^{x} = 2\) hai (x subscript nahin, power hai).
Sab kuch ek taraf le ja kar \(f(x) = xe^{x} - 2\) banayein.
Plan: \(x = 0\) aur \(x = 1\) daal kar sign change dekhein, phir Regula-Falsi chalayein jab tak \(|f(c)| < 0.005\) na ho.
Aakhir mein \(\pm 0.005\) wali tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(xe^{x} = 2\) (interval nahin diya, pehle khud dhoondna hai).
Maloom karna: root jo 2 decimal places tak sahi ho.
Tareeqa: Regula-Falsi (false position). Do points \((a, f(a))\) aur \((b, f(b))\) ko seedhi line (secant line) se jorte hain; yeh line x-axis ko jahan kaatti hai woh naya andaza \(c\) hai: \(c = \frac{a f(b) - b f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\). Phir woh hissa rakhte hain jahan sign abhi bhi badal raha ho. 2 decimal places ke liye tolerance \(|f(c)| < 0.005\) hai; beech ki values 4 decimals tak.

Equation ko \(f(x) = 0\) ki shakal mein likhein aur sign change dhoondein
\[f(x) = xe^{x} - 2\]\[f(0) = 0 - 2 = -2\]\[f(1) = e - 2 = 0.7183\]Yani \(f(0)\,f(1) < 0\).
Kyun: \(f\) har jagah continuous hai (\(x\) aur \(e^{x}\) dono continuous, aur un ka product bhi). Continuous function ka sign badle to LRT kehta hai ke beech mein root zaroor hai; isi liye hum ne choti si values (0 aur 1) daal kar sign change dhoonda.

Iteration 1: \(a = 0,\ b = 1\), \(f(a) = -2,\ f(b) = 0.7183\)
\[c = \dfrac{a f(b) - b f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\]\[= \dfrac{(0)(0.7183) - (1)(-2)}{0.7183 - (-2)}\]\[= 0.7358\]\[f(0.7358) = -0.4643 < 0\]
Root ab \([0.7358, 1]\) mein hai, is liye \(a = c\).
Kyun: \(f(c)\) ka sign \(f(a)\) jaisa hai, is liye \(a\) hata kar \(c\) rakha; sign change ab \(c\) aur \(b\) ke beech hai.
Dhyan dein: formula mein negative values bracket ke saath likhein, warna minus ka sign gum ho jata hai.

Iteration 2: \(a = 0.7358,\ b = 1\), \(f(a) = -0.4643,\ f(b) = 0.7183\)
\[c = \dfrac{a f(b) - b f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\]\[= \dfrac{(0.7358)(0.7183) - (1)(-0.4643)}{0.7183 - (-0.4643)}\]\[= 0.8395\]\[f(0.8395) = -0.0564 < 0\]
Root ab \([0.8395, 1]\) mein hai, is liye \(a = c\).
Kyun: \(f(c)\) ka sign \(f(a)\) jaisa hai, is liye \(a\) hata kar \(c\) rakha; sign change ab \(c\) aur \(b\) ke beech hai.
Dhyan dein: formula mein negative values bracket ke saath likhein, warna minus ka sign gum ho jata hai.

Isi tarah aage (table)
Table mein har iteration likhi hai. Ghaur karein ke \(b\) wala sira apni jagah se hilta hi nahin: curve poore hisse mein ek hi taraf mura hua hai, is liye secant line har dafa root ke ek hi taraf axis ko kaatti hai.
Kyun: Regula-Falsi mein sirf woh sira badalta hai jis ka sign \(f(c)\) jaisa ho. Bisection ki tarah dono siron ki bari bari nahin aati.

Rukna kab hai
\[|f(0.8525)| = 0.0005 < 0.005\]Is liye \(c = 0.8525\) kaafi hai; 2 decimal places tak \(x \approx 0.85\).
Kyun: \(n = 2\) ke liye 8.3.1 ki tolerance \(|f(c)| < 0.005\) hai, aur yeh poori ho gayi.

Tasdeeq:
\[f(0.845) = -0.0329\]\[f(0.855) = 0.0104\]Sign ulte hain, is liye asal root 0.845 aur 0.855 ke darmiyan hai, aur woh round ho kar 0.85 hi banta hai. Jawab pakka hai.

blocks.text: Kitab ne equation \(xe_x = 2\) chhapi hai (x neeche subscript mein). Sahi \(xe^{x} = 2\) hai, yani x power mein; answer key ka 0.85 bhi isi ki tasdeeq karta hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iv) Find the real roots of nonlinear equations correct to 2 decimal places using the Regula-Falsi method, by finding some interval of sign change if not specified. \(3x + \sin x = e^{x}\)
blocks.explanation:
Interval nahin diya; equation \(3x + \sin x = e^{x}\) hai.
Pehle sab ek taraf: \(f(x) = 3x + \sin x - e^{x}\).
Values daal kar dekhein: \(f(0) < 0\), \(f(1) > 0\), \(f(2) < 0\), yani do jagah sign badalta hai, is liye do real roots hain.
Plan: pehle \([0, 1]\) wala root Regula-Falsi se, phir \([1, 2]\) wala.
Tolerance 0.005, radian mode.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(3x + \sin x = e^{x}\) (interval nahin diya, pehle khud dhoondna hai).
Maloom karna: root jo 2 decimal places tak sahi ho.
Tareeqa: Regula-Falsi (false position). Do points \((a, f(a))\) aur \((b, f(b))\) ko seedhi line (secant line) se jorte hain; yeh line x-axis ko jahan kaatti hai woh naya andaza \(c\) hai: \(c = \frac{a f(b) - b f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\). Phir woh hissa rakhte hain jahan sign abhi bhi badal raha ho. 2 decimal places ke liye tolerance \(|f(c)| < 0.005\) hai; beech ki values 4 decimals tak.

Equation ko \(f(x) = 0\) ki shakal mein likhein aur sign change dhoondein
\[f(x) = 3x + \sin x - e^{x}\]\[f(0) = 0 + 0 - 1 = -1\]\[f(1) = 3 + 0.8415 - 2.7183\]\[= 1.1232\]Yani \(f(0)\,f(1) < 0\).
Kyun: \(f\) har jagah continuous hai (linear, sine aur exponential sab continuous hain). Continuous function ka sign badle to LRT kehta hai ke beech mein root zaroor hai; isi liye hum ne choti si values (0 aur 1) daal kar sign change dhoonda.

Iteration 1: \(a = 0,\ b = 1\), \(f(a) = -1,\ f(b) = 1.1232\)
\[c = \dfrac{a f(b) - b f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\]\[= \dfrac{(0)(1.1232) - (1)(-1)}{1.1232 - (-1)}\]\[= 0.471\]\[f(0.471) = 0.2652 > 0\]
Root ab \([0, 0.471]\) mein hai, is liye \(b = c\).
Kyun: \(f(c)\) ka sign \(f(b)\) jaisa hai, is liye \(b\) hata kar \(c\) rakha; sign change ab \(a\) aur \(c\) ke beech hai.
Dhyan dein: formula mein negative values bracket ke saath likhein, warna minus ka sign gum ho jata hai.

Iteration 2: \(a = 0,\ b = 0.471\), \(f(a) = -1,\ f(b) = 0.2652\)
\[c = \dfrac{a f(b) - b f(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\]\[= \dfrac{(0)(0.2652) - (0.471)(-1)}{0.2652 - (-1)}\]\[= 0.3723\]\[f(0.3723) = 0.0296 > 0\]
Root ab \([0, 0.3723]\) mein hai, is liye \(b = c\).
Kyun: \(f(c)\) ka sign \(f(b)\) jaisa hai, is liye \(b\) hata kar \(c\) rakha; sign change ab \(a\) aur \(c\) ke beech hai.
Dhyan dein: formula mein negative values bracket ke saath likhein, warna minus ka sign gum ho jata hai.

Isi tarah aage (table)
Table mein har iteration likhi hai. Ghaur karein ke \(a\) wala sira apni jagah se hilta hi nahin: curve poore hisse mein ek hi taraf mura hua hai, is liye secant line har dafa root ke ek hi taraf axis ko kaatti hai.
Kyun: Regula-Falsi mein sirf woh sira badalta hai jis ka sign \(f(c)\) jaisa ho. Bisection ki tarah dono siron ki bari bari nahin aati.

Rukna kab hai
\[|f(0.3616)| = 0.0029 < 0.005\]Is liye \(c = 0.3616\) kaafi hai; 2 decimal places tak \(x \approx 0.36\).
Kyun: \(n = 2\) ke liye 8.3.1 ki tolerance \(|f(c)| < 0.005\) hai, aur yeh poori ho gayi.

Doosra root
\[f(2) = 6 + 0.9093 - 7.3891 = -0.4798\]Yani \([1, 2]\) par bhi sign badalta hai. Wahan Regula-Falsi lagayein (sira \(b = 2\) apni jagah rehta hai):
\[c_1 = 1.7007,\ f = 0.6159\]\[c_2 = 1.8689,\ f = 0.0814\]\[c_3 = 1.8879,\ f = 0.0084\]\[c_4 = 1.8898,\ f = 0.0009\]Kyun: \(|f(1.8898)| = 0.0009 < 0.005\), is liye doosra root \(x \approx 1.89\) hai; \(f(1.885) > 0 > f(1.895)\) is ki tasdeeq karta hai. Sawal "real roots" poochta hai, is liye dono roots likhna behtar hai.

Tasdeeq:
\[f(0.355) = -0.0136\]\[f(0.365) = 0.0114\]Sign ulte hain, is liye asal root 0.355 aur 0.365 ke darmiyan hai, aur woh round ho kar 0.36 hi banta hai. Jawab pakka hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key sirf 0.36 deti hai, lekin is equation ka ek doosra real root bhi hai: \(f(1) > 0\) aur \(f(2) = -0.4798 < 0\). \([1, 2]\) par Regula-Falsi se 1.7007, 1.8689, 1.8879, 1.8898 milte hain aur \(|f(1.8898)| = 0.0009 < 0.005\), is liye doosra root \(x \approx 1.89\) hai.
